title: Halloween Costume Contest and Prize Giveaway at the Festival
originalTitle: 【DREAMHACK】streaming the COSPLAY CONTEST straight from the venue! (read description)
lead: The host began by expressing excitement and congratulations to the participants, emphasizing the fun and creativity of the Halloween costume contest. They mentioned that the event was a success and that the costumes were impressive.
summaryOneLine: The host began by expressing excitement and congratulations to the participants, emphasizing the fun and creativity of the Halloween costume contest. They mentioned that the event was a success and that the costumes were impressive.
articleBodyHtml:
Introduction and Congratulations

The host began by expressing excitement and congratulations to the participants, emphasizing the fun and creativity of the Halloween costume contest. They mentioned that the event was a success and that the costumes were impressive.

The host praised the costumes and the effort put into them, highlighting the creativity and dedication of the participants. They also thanked the judges for their time and support.

Prize Distribution and Audience Involvement

The host mentioned that there were still prizes to give away and asked for help in distributing them. They encouraged the audience to participate and assist in the process.

The host highlighted the value of the prizes, mentioning that there were prizes worth 20K and that contestants were being rewarded for participating in the event. They emphasized the generosity of the organizers.

Prize Giveaways and Contestant Recognition

Poison Ivy was given a prize, and the host confirmed that she was still present at the event. They also mentioned that she was back with the Riller, showing her continued involvement.

The host praised Poison Ivy's costume and mentioned that the Artix Nova prize was given to one of their favorites. They highlighted the quality of the costumes and the effort put in by the participants.

Additional Prizes and Audience Engagement

The host decided to give a prize to Blade, one of their favorite characters, and mentioned that the love for the event was real. They expressed appreciation for the audience's support and enthusiasm.

The host decided to give the Artix Nova prize to the Corpse Bride couple, praising their performance. They highlighted the couple's creativity and the impact of their costume on the audience.

Gratitude and Closing Remarks

The speaker thanked Kira, Emily, and Dwight for joining and participating in the event. They expressed gratitude for their contributions and the time they spent judging the contest.

The speaker announced that the Fallout Cosplayer (number 15) won a prize. They praised the cosplayer's effort and the quality of the costume.

The speaker mentioned that there were more prizes available for the audience, including gift cards. They encouraged the audience to continue participating and enjoying the event.

The speaker thanked the audience for their hard work and participation, and thanked Emily, Dwight, and Kira for judging. They emphasized the importance of the audience's support and the success of the event.

The speaker thanked everyone for attending, wished them a great rest of their weekend, and encouraged them to continue supporting each other for the remaining days of the festival. They concluded with a Happy Halloween message.

Additional Information and Promotions

The speaker mentioned a workplace comedy set in the high stakes world of e-sports logistics, where diffusing a problem requires more than just a kid. They also mentioned a dispatch that gives you wings.

The speaker mentioned that Zenni offers affordable eyewear for various needs, including sunglasses, blue light glasses, and night driving lenses. They encouraged the audience to visit zenni.com for more information.
